mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 1.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in monetary easing cycles despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) creates a dual tightening labor market and loose monetary policy environment, amplifying equity demand and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: tightening labor market and loose monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in 20d despite FEDFUNDS rise and UNRATE fall, or interaction strength (Rank IC) < 0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) in an expanding economy signals robust demand, lowering discount rates and increasing corporate earnings expectations, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in 60d despite GDPC1 rising in the past quarter, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 3.5% during recessionary conditions weakens labor market confidence, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive in 5d despite UNRATE rising above 3.5%, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in industrial production (INDPRO) alongside a decline in the federal funds rate below 1% indicates expansionary policy, boosting sectoral activity and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in 20d despite INDPRO rise and FEDFUNDS below 1%, or interaction strength (Rank IC) < 0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in the federal funds rate signals policy accommodation, lowering discount rates and enhancing equity valuations, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in 60d during late-cycle expansion despite FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) coupled with falling unemployment (UNRATE) strengthens labor market confidence, stimulating consumer spending and corporate investment, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in 20d despite PAYEMS rise and UNRATE fall, or interaction strength (Rank IC) < 0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in industrial production (INDPRO) during an expanding economy signals robust supply-side activity, lowering production costs and boosting corporate profits, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in 5d despite INDPRO rising in the past quarter, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
